biotools.summary: irAExplorer is a database that explores the landscape of immune checkpoint inhibitor-induced adverse events. It aggregates clinical trial data from ClinicalTrials.gov to provide insights into the incidence of serious adverse events across cancer types, treatment agents, and regimens.
